model_annotation: Figure 6 presents a line plot illustrating the training dynamics of Luffy compared with on-policy RL. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and is linear, with a value range from 0 to 500. The y-axis is labeled "Outcome Training Rewards" and is linear, with a value range from 0 to 1.2. The plot features two lines: one representing "On-Policy RL" and the other representing "Luffy." The "On-Policy RL" line is colored red, has a solid line style, and shows a steady increase in outcome training rewards as the number of steps increases. The "Luffy" line is colored blue, has a dashed line style, and exhibits a more variable pattern, with several peaks and declines in outcome training rewards throughout the training process. The plot is part of a study on the training dynamics of Luffy, which is a model that learns from off-policy traces and is compared to on-policy RL to highlight its ability to adapt and improve its performance over time.
